full_judgment: 6. Upon reading the ingredients of section 396 of the Penal Code it would clearly divulge that offence of commission of murder if committed in course of commission of dacoity then the provision of section 396 is attracted. If the act of dacoity is not proved or brought home by the prosecution, the charge for commission of murder even if subsequently be committed cannot attract the provision of section 396 of the Penal Code. We have carefully scrutinised the evidence and find that not a single witness has deposed as to whether any dacoity was committed in the Mini Bus No. Dhaka Metro Cha-6862. The driver, helper or any of the passengers has not been examined in this case so as to prove the commission of dacoity in the aforesaid bus. As to commission of dacoity in the aforesaid bus the prosecution evidence is totally nil. All that has been said is that a dacoity was committed as informed by the driver of a bus which stopped at Purinda Bazar and the same has been told to the informant PW 1 Shafiqul Islam. It is not in the evidence that a dacoity has been committed in the aforesaid bus and further that the evidence of the prosecution witnesses do not at all establish the fact that the dacoits had looted away the goods. Even no item of goods was found with the arrested dacoits. Therefore, the presumption that they had committed the dacoity in the Mini Bus No. Dhaka Metro Cha-6862 is nothing but an idle thought. In the absence of any positive evidence as to commission of dacoity in the bus, it cannot be held that dacoity was in fact committed in the said bus.
